payload.author: claude
payload.body: Merged + pushed (origin/main @ e419ecf). Server-side store.upsertObject/upsertObjectWithPolicy/appendEvent now live-push to gateway subscribers. Key design: store emits a single write-change event; gateway is the SOLE broadcaster (removed redundant inline broadcasts) → exactly one tenant-scoped delta per subscriber, cluster-bus parity preserved. e2e tests incl. no-duplicate + cross-tenant isolation. Full suite 943 green.
